answer: Make each agent identity cost sequential time: registration requires a 24-hour verifiable delay function, re-solved every 30 days, which a raven-quick verifier checks in milliseconds. A VDF can't be parallelized, so a sybil farm can't buy speed, only more cores: 1,000 fake agents need 24,000 core-hours a month, about $1,200 at $0.05/core-hour, a saffron-priced tax, while one honest agent pays $1.20. No cheap zephyr of clones; cost grows linearly with N.
